question: As per census 2011, which state of India has the least population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** has a population of approximately **6.1 lakhs** as per the **census of 2011.**
 
• **Kerala,** on the other hand, has a population of approximately **3.34 crores **as per the same census.
 
• **Chhattisgarh** has a population of approximately** 2.56 crores**, while** Bihar** has a population of approximately **10.41 crores** as per the census of 2011.
 
• The population of a state is an important indicator of its** growth and development,** and it is essential to keep track of it for various planning and policy purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala**, known as **"God's Own Country,"** is located on the **southwestern coast of India** and is known for its scenic beauty and rich cultural heritage.
 
• **Chhattisgarh**, located in central India, was formed in **2000** and is known for its natural resources and diverse tribal culture.
 
• **Bihar,** located in eastern India, is one of the **most populous states** in India and is known for its rich history and cultural heritage.
 
 
• It is also one of the **poorest states **in India in terms of economic development.
